source.raw_prompt: Verify that the Architect subagent's tool permission boundary (Read, Grep, Glob only) is correctly enforced and that it can produce evidence-based findings without modifying or executing anything.

objective: Verify that the Architect can inspect the approved repository areas and return evidence-based findings without modifying or executing anything.
constraints: Architect tools must remain exactly Read, Grep, Glob
Architect must not receive Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Bash, PowerShell, or other execution tools
Architect must return raw JSON rather than write files

acceptance_criteria.description: Architect reads the supplied scope and findings contract
Architect uses Read, Grep, and Glob during research
Architect returns a schema-compatible findings object
Architect creates no file and performs no command execution

task_graph.description: Verify Architect permission boundary and produce findings
